summary: A separate authored groom document containing a stable root population, volume graph and lazy field expressions.

population.doc: Stable logical follicle population, independent of derived sample density.

scalp.doc: Head scalp topology binding independent of selected hairstyle; density and length are authored scalp-space maps.

density.description: Resolved seed projection or legacy root-map data. The current persistence adapter omits derived seed samples from new authored documents.

binding.description: Derived geometry-revision sampling cache, accepted in legacy inputs but rebuilt in the worker and omitted from new authored documents.

graph.doc: Root, field-selected section partitions, clump volumes, disjoint convergence and termination. Section and clump IDs are authored graph labels. Convergence may hold a head-space tie sphere without replacing member roots.

fields.doc: Named expressions with declared units and charts; evaluated only at requested material samples.

solver.doc: Deterministic evaluation budgets and compliant constraints.

flow.doc: Shared growth field: normalised lateral part position, shallow emergence angle, forehead sweep, crown lift and rear-section routing. Optional partCombing is a dimensionless [away-from-part, upward, rearward] vector, mirrored across the part. An explicit foreheadDirection overrides it. Style names never choose solver code.

cut.doc: Optional head-space tip plane. Style and settle the intrinsic fibre first, then trim at its first downward crossing; report the retained intrinsic length.

x-document: Serialized separately as xfs/hair-groom-part-1; never insert into the imported save, character choices or existing makeup draft.
x-validation: The operator contract in hair-population validates complete graph and expression shapes before evaluation; schema validation alone is not semantic validation.
x-attachment: Generate in bind-pose head space and attach rigidly to Head; down vector is bind-pose gravity. Hairstyle changes never reseed density.
